summary.name: Doodle Art (Drawing and Illustration category, explicit provenance). The source states it is distinct from graffiti.
summary.visualIdentity: Simple contours, expressive faces and a few exaggerated details give a casual drawing rhythm. Forms stay consistent, colors stay light and backgrounds stay quiet. Characters use a few drawn paths and replaceable expression groups. Doodle art is explicitly distinct from graffiti.
summary.suitableUses: Source-stated fit: casual explainers and social content used alone. Mascot shorts, reaction beats and vertical meme-style explainers are inferred suitability, not verified. Hybridize for long character holds or when captions must carry the punchline. Audience, duration and aspect ratio are unspecified.
summary.limitations: Avoid arbitrary shaking, identical expressions every scene and boiling backgrounds. Rough.js gives sketch contours and hachure fills but not handwriting, paper texture, rigs or poses, so it cannot establish authentic pencil or ink media. Gaze following needs suitable eye layers or a rig. Physical media limits beyond these are unspecified.
summary.palette: Background is scene-dependent: #FFFBF2 is an illustrative swatch, not a required canvas, so choose a quiet field from subject, environment and mood. Suggested tokens: foreground #34343D, accent_1 #E6AF9C, accent_2 #94C1B3, with no gradient. Foreground on background is 11.928:1; foreground on accent_1 is 6.439:1 and on accent_2 is 6.182:1. Task-supplied exact colors override these suggestions. Sampled frames (seconds 1–8, two sources) suggest one dark ink and one accent family; sampled hues are not tokens.
summary.motionAndInteraction: Animate clear poses, short reactions and natural pauses, not identical expressions or arbitrary shaking. A gentle line boil that swaps two fixed contour variants during holds is a suggestion. Gaze following (motion-006), chapter handoffs (motion-012) and story steps (motion-015) are optional and need suitable layers. Video runs on composition time; live interaction behavior is unspecified.
summary.audio: Source specifies no audio. Propose music, voiceover, sound effects, ambience or silence from topic and motion cadence without mandating any layer. Sound accents may mark key poses or transitions while keeping narration uncompeted. No audio was verified in source review; any soundtrack must be actually created or supplied and checked.
summary.assetRequirements: Characters need a few drawn paths, replaceable expression groups and fixed line variants. Fonts and any supplied assets must load before rendering. Exact copy, artwork and reference colors are optional task inputs. Source file formats are unspecified, and later scenes beyond sampled seconds 1–8 were not verified.
summary.combinations: Style-092 (gentle line boil) boils only contours during pauses while fills #E6AF9C and #94C1B3 stay fixed and backgrounds stay still. Style-115 (reaction captions) adds one short caption per beat in #34343D on #FFFBF2 or accent chips, never over faces. Both pairings are source suggestions, not verified compatibility.
summary.productionApproach: HyperFrames is the primary render pipeline (data-composition-id, paused GSAP timeline in window.__timelines, check, snapshot, render); Remotion applies only on its documented fallback condition. Visuals: SVG and Canvas 2D are primary; optional Rough.js (seeded sketch contours), Paper.js (vector paths and booleans), PixiJS (layered sprites), tldraw (editable art export) and chroma.js (contrast checks). GSAP owns timing; Motion is optional. Verify seeks and palette in composited frames.
